Test coverage across every test type, and fixes found by it:

ArchUnitTS architecture rules for backend and frontend (`tests/archunit.test.ts`): dependency direction between web, API, shared, publisher, agent runner and scripts; components independent of views; production code independent of tests; no import cycles with type imports included; PascalCase views and components, kebab-case modules; file size budgets; slices adhere to `docs/architecture/components.puml`. Separate API and web images: `docker/api.Dockerfile` (API and worker) and `docker/web.Dockerfile` (nginx with CSP and security headers, SPA deep links). _Both images built; worker start-up through Git Bash needed `MSYS_NO_PATHCONV`. `pnpm smoke:web` (`scripts/smoke-web-image.ts`) builds the web image, runs it against a stub API and passes 15 checks: health, CSP and security headers on the shell and assets, no-cache shell, immutable gzip assets, deep-link fallback, 404 for missing assets, `/api`
